BiblicalUsage: A fortress is the word for a fortified place, and it appears twice, both times in the reign of a good king building up Judah. In 2 Chronicles 17:12 Jehoshaphat waxed great exceedingly, and built in Judah castles and cities of store. In 2 Chronicles 27:4 Jotham built cities in the mountains of Judah, and in the forests he built castles and towers.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the castles of Jehoshaphat and Jotham are a picture of wise strength: build the walls while there is peace, so they stand when there is war.
